---
title: "ACE"
pagetitle: "ACE: Audit Clinical Evidence"
# Link-preview text only (og:description); the page itself does not show it.
description: "Independent audits of published clinical research for statistical errors, data inconsistencies, and research integrity violations."

# The home page draws its own layout edge to edge (styles.css, "HOME PAGE");
# no title block, no table of contents, no sidebar.
page-layout: custom
toc: false
body-classes: homepage
resources:
  - ace-home.js

# Three views of the same reports, each with its own template. Drafts are
# left out of all three, as they are from the Reports page.
#   ace-ticker  the scrolling strip of findings (each report's `highlights:`)
#   ace-totals  the four numbers under the hero (summed across reports)
#   ace-latest  the two newest reports, as cards (same template as Reports)
listing:
  - id: ace-ticker
    contents: "reports/*/index.qmd"
    template: _ace-home-ticker.ejs.md
    fields: [title, ace-id, highlights]
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: ace-totals
    contents: "reports/*/index.qmd"
    template: _ace-home-totals.ejs.md
    fields: [title, ace-id, impact, violations]
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: ace-latest
    contents: "reports/*/index.qmd"
    template: _ace-report-listing.ejs.md
    fields: [title, subtitle, abstract, categories, date, date-modified, ace-id, doi, concept-doi, impact, violations, recommendation, population, treatment, outcome, design]
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 2
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
---

<div class="ace-home-band" id="how"><div class="ace-wrap">
<div class="ace-home-head">
  <div><span class="ace-eyebrow">How an audit works</span><h2 class="ace-home-h2">Four steps</h2></div>
  <p>The same sequence for every report, from the first anomaly to a letter on the editor's desk.</p>
</div>
<ol class="ace-steps">
  <li class="ace-step"><span class="ace-step-n">01</span><h3>Find</h3><p>We identify errors in published articles via the tables, text, figures, trial registrations, supplements, and article metadata.</p></li>
  <li class="ace-step"><span class="ace-step-n">02</span><h3>Document</h3><p>Each finding and the relevant evidence is documented in the form of an audit report.</p></li>
  <li class="ace-step"><span class="ace-step-n">03</span><h3>Publish</h3><p>Reports are open access under CC BY 4.0, archived on Zenodo with a DOI, and versioned whenever they change.</p></li>
  <li class="ace-step"><span class="ace-step-n">04</span><h3>Report</h3><p>We send the report to the journal's editors and research integrity office, and <a class="ace-ui ace-inline" href="correspondence.html">follow the letter publicly</a> until the journal makes a decision.</p></li>
</ol>
<div class="ace-standard">
  <span class="ace-eyebrow">Every finding must be</span>
  <ul>
    <li>Observable in the public record</li>
    <li>Reproducible by an independent reader</li>
    <li>Supported by the evidence</li>
  </ul>
</div>
</div></div>

<div class="ace-home-band" id="ace-riv-band"><div class="ace-wrap">
